export.title: Your data
export.body: Download a JSON file of everything stored about you: your profile, game accounts and their settings, run history, logs, notifications and your own actions. Game passwords are never included.
delete.title: Delete account
delete.body: This stops your bots and permanently deletes your account, game accounts, settings, logs and notifications. It can't be undone.
delete.modalBody: Your bots stop and everything is deleted for good. Enter your password and type your username, {{username}}, to confirm.

plugins.bladeSetup.missing: Still to choose: {{list}}. The plugin waits until all are set.

plugins.commanderPicker.title: Commanders
plugins.commanderPicker.intro: Click the commanders in the order the bot should send them. Click a picked one again to take it out.
plugins.commanderPicker.shared: One list for every attack on this page.
plugins.commanderPicker.none: None picked: the bot sends any of your commanders, in the order that suits each attack.
plugins.commanderPicker.beyond: Dimmed numbers are commanders you don’t have yet. The bot skips them until you do.
plugins.commanderPicker.vipHelp: The most VIP commanders the bot may use each day, from 0 to 300. The bot never goes beyond the free daily allowance of your VIP level. It is saved now. The bot starts using VIP commanders in a later update.
plugins.commanderPicker.mixed: The attacks on this page had different commander lists. This shows the first one, and saving uses it for all.
plugins.commanderPicker.mapped: This account has a commander map, so the bot does not read this list. The map decides which commanders these attacks send.
plugins.commanderMap.intro: While any commander is assigned, only assigned commanders are sent out. A plugin sends its own commanders first, then its group’s, and a plugin with none sends nothing. Auto Station is the exception: with none assigned it keeps its own commander list, so it can still move troops out. With no commander assigned at all, every plugin keeps its own commander list.
plugins.commanderMap.tilesHelp: Or click a commander to give it to the owner picked above ({{owner}}). Click it again to take it away. Commanders with an owner are underlined.
plugins.commanderMap.starved: On with no commanders, so it sends nothing
plugins.dialog.staged: {{plugin}} settings are set. They are saved with the new account.

overview.problems.kept: The last {{count}} kinds of refusal are kept, also after the bot stops.

liveView.session.none: No session yet. Start the bot and what it gains shows here.
liveView.castles.title: Castle stores
liveView.castles.none: The game hasn't listed this account's castle stores yet. They show up after the bot's next look at its castles.
liveView.marches.title: Marches
liveView.marches.noneOfSide: No marches of this kind under way.
liveView.marches.shown: Showing the first {{shown}} of {{count}} marches. Those at this account come first.
liveView.blade.title: Blade Coast · level {{level}} of {{count}} ({{map}})
liveView.blade.goods: In the camp: wood {{wood}}, stone {{stone}}, food {{food}}. Storage holds {{storage}} of each.
liveView.blade.noTrips: Nothing is on its way to or from the camp.
liveView.defence.title: Main castle defence
liveView.defence.none: The bot hasn't read the main castle's defence yet. It looks a few minutes after it signs in, and again every 15 to 25 minutes.
liveView.defence.lockedHint: Each flank's fifth tool slot opens with the legendary skill for it.
liveView.rage.title: Khan rage
liveView.rage.none: Nothing to show. The rage bar appears while the Khan plugin is on and the game has opened the Khan event.
liveView.rage.meterUnknown: {{rage}} rage. The bot learns what a full bar takes when it first attacks a camp.
liveView.rage.state.filling: Filling. The bot spends a full bar on a taunt.
liveView.rage.state.full: The bar is full. The bot taunts the Khan next.
liveView.rage.hold.off: The bot isn't taunting. Tablets only or log only is on in the Khan plugin.
liveView.rage.hold.stopped: The Khan plugin has stopped for this event.
liveView.rage.hold.defenceLost: Taunts are on hold. The castle lost a defence against the Khan.
liveView.rage.hold.defenceShort: Taunts are on hold. Storage can't refill the defence.
liveView.rage.hold.defendersShort: Taunts are on hold. The main castle has too few defenders.
liveView.rage.hold.toolsShort: Taunts are on hold. A defended wall side has a slot with fewer than 10 tools.
liveView.rage.hold.defenceUnread: Taunts are on hold. The bot couldn't read the main castle's defence.
dashboard.kpi.basis: Attacks and errors are counted from the log lines kept for each account: the newest {{count, number}}, and none older than {{days, number}} days. A plus means some lines may have been dropped, so the real figure is at least that. Lines the game said not now to are not errors.
dashboard.kpi.failed: Couldn't count attacks and errors. They refresh in a minute.
dashboard.top.title: Top accounts
dashboard.top.window: by attacks in the last {{hours, number}} hours
dashboard.top.emptyHint: Turn on an attack plugin on an account and start it. The accounts that attack most appear here.
modules.live-view.name: Live view
modules.live-view.description: What the bot last read from the game: each castle's stores, the marches on the map and what this session gained.
modules.castle-manager.name: Castle manager
modules.castle-manager.description: Tools to look after your castles' buildings and upgrades from one page.
modules.offer-buyer.name: Offer buyer
modules.offer-buyer.description: Watches the shop for offers you pick and buys them when they appear.
modules.wheel-spin.name: Wheel spin
modules.wheel-spin.description: Spins the Wheel of Fortune and the Wheel of Unimaginable Affluence with the tickets you hold. It keeps the tickets you set aside and stops at your daily limit.
modules.overseers.name: Overseers
modules.overseers.description: Manages your overseers so their bonuses stay running.
modules.food-manager.name: Food manager
modules.food-manager.description: Keeps food and mead moving between your castles so troops are never short.
modules.messages.name: Messages
modules.messages.description: Copies your alliance chat to a Discord channel and sends what you write there back to the game.
modules.rift-raid.name: Rift raid
modules.rift-raid.description: Runs the rift raid event for you, with the army you choose for each attack.
modules.berimond.name: Berimond
modules.berimond.description: Takes part in Berimond battles on the side you pick, refilling troops and tools as it goes.
modules.towers.name: Towers
modules.towers.description: Attacks Robber Baron castles in every kingdom, with the commanders you allow. Each kingdom has its own switch and settings.
modules.leveller.name: Leveller
modules.leveller.description: Raises an account's level by attacking a list of targets you give it, then stops when the list runs out.
modules.armourer.name: Armourer
modules.armourer.description: Buys siege tools from the armourer with coins whenever a castle holds fewer than the minimum you set.
modules.blacksmith-event-shops.name: Blacksmith and event shops
modules.blacksmith-event-shops.descripti: Spends event currency in the shops in the order you choose, up to limits you set.
modules.nom-sam-daimyo.name: Nomads, Samurai and Daimyo
modules.nom-sam-daimyo.description: Attacks the Nomad and Samurai camps and the Daimyo castles with the commanders you allow.
modules.storms.name: Storms
modules.storms.description: Attacks the Storm Islands fortresses and sends mead to your Storm Islands castle so it doesn't run out.
modules.fortress.name: Fortress
modules.fortress.description: Attacks the fortresses in Burning Sands, Everwinter Glacier and Fire Peaks with the commanders you allow. Each has its own tab.
modules.khan.name: Khan
modules.khan.description: Attacks Khan camps during the Khan event, up to the score you set.
modules.green-berimond.name: Green Berimond
modules.green-berimond.description: Attacks during the Berimond Invasion event and uses event tools to earn points.
modules.invasion-events.name: Invasion events
modules.invasion-events.description: Attacks Foreign Lords' camps and Bloodcrow camps during their events, until the event ends or your score is reached.
modules.blade-coast.name: Blade Coast
modules.blade-coast.description: Plays the Blade Coast event for you: builds the camp, supplies it from one castle, upgrades the warship and attacks the islands up to the Kraken. It never pays with rubies.
modules.virtual-presets.name: Virtual presets
modules.virtual-presets.description: Saves attack waves under a name, so any module can reuse them without the in-game presets.
modules.coin-farmer.name: Coin farmer
modules.coin-farmer.description: Farms coins on the event server's twin of your account.
modules.bth-blacksmith.name: BTH blacksmith
modules.bth-blacksmith.description: Works the blacksmith on the event server's twin of your account.
modules.influence-farming.name: Influence farming
modules.influence-farming.description: Collects influence on the event server's twin of your account.
modules.recruiter.name: Recruiter
modules.recruiter.description: Recruits troops for the event server's twin of your account.
modules.castle-builder.name: Castle builder
modules.castle-builder.description: Builds up the castle on the event server's twin of your account.
modules.equipment-manager.name: Equipment manager
modules.equipment-manager.description: Sorts and fits gear for the event server's twin of your account.
modules.or-storms.name: Outer realms storms
modules.or-storms.description: Attacks storm forts on the event server's twin of your account.
modules.mp-builder.name: MP builder
modules.mp-builder.description: Builds the event server's mighty place from the twin of your account.
modules.recruit-tools-heal.name: Recruit, tools and heal
modules.recruit-tools-heal.description: Keeps each castle's troops and tools at the stock you set, ordering from the barracks and the workshops with coins and resources, and heals the wounded with coins.
modules.refinery-toolsmith.name: Toolsmith
modules.refinery-toolsmith.description: Builds siege and defence tools in your workshops until each one reaches the stock you set.
modules.auto-feast.name: Auto-feast
modules.auto-feast.description: Starts feasts in your castles when they hold more food than you need.
modules.equip-sell.name: Equip sell
modules.equip-sell.description: Sells the equipment colours you pick and loose gems from your storage, a few at a time, and never set pieces.
modules.daily-chores.name: Daily chores
modules.daily-chores.description: Claims the daily login bonus, sends the tax collector out, and asks your alliance for help.
modules.troop-transfer.name: Troop transfer
modules.troop-transfer.description: Keeps troops and tools stocked in your kingdoms. When a kingdom runs low, another kingdom's castle sends enough to fill it back up.
modules.alliance-donations.name: Alliance donations
modules.alliance-donations.description: Gives your alliance the resources and coins your castles hold above what you keep, and gives wood and stone to the Colossus during its event.
modules.native-village.name: Native village
modules.native-village.description: Spends the olive oil, charcoal and glass in your kingdom castles on the native village pack you pick for each kingdom.
modules.alert-autostation.name: Alert and autostation
modules.alert-autostation.description: When a player attacks one of your castles, moves its troops to a protected alliance castle before the attack lands.
modules.asset-monitor.name: Asset monitor
modules.asset-monitor.description: Keeps watch on the castles of other players and tells you when something changes.
modules.discord-attacks.name: Discord attack alerts
modules.discord-attacks.description: Posts attacks on you and your own attacks to Discord channels.
modules.discord-events.name: Discord event alerts
modules.discord-events.description: Keeps one Discord message up to date each for the fortresses, the Aquamarine Islands and the Aquamarine Towers.

army.summary.plan: Waves written: {{waves}} of {{total}} · Support tools: {{supportTools}} · Courtyard rows: {{courtyard}}
waves.intro: Write 1 to 25 waves, 4 to begin with. The last wave is sent again for each wave after it, so the castle needs troops for those too.
waves.cap: The game sends at most 4 waves at level 51 and above, plus any the commander adds. Waves past that are kept but not sent.
waves.copyRest: Apply to the rest of the waves
waves.kind.label: Wave {{n}} comes from
waves.preset.label: In-game preset for wave {{n}}
waves.preset.note: Pick a preset saved in the game. Each attack sends what the preset holds then. The list is what the bot last read from the game.
waves.preset.unread: The bot hasn't read this account's in-game presets yet. It reads them a few minutes after it starts, or with its first attack.
waves.preset.warning: A wave uses a preset the game didn't list when the bot last read it. The module won't start until that preset is saved in the game or the wave is changed.
waves.support.title: Support tools
waves.courtyard.title: Courtyard troops
waves.amountHint: An amount above what a side holds fills the side. The bot waits while the castle holds less than a slot needs.
army.summary.virtualMissing: This virtual preset was deleted. Pick another one.
waves.source.label: Waves come from
waves.source.none: This account has no virtual presets yet. Make one on the Virtual presets page to reuse it across modules.
waves.source.virtualNote: The module sends this preset's waves. A change to the preset reaches the module by itself.
presets.title: Presets of {{name}}
presets.empty: No virtual presets yet. A preset is a set of waves under a name, which any attack module of this account can send.
presets.limit: An account keeps up to {{max}} virtual presets.
presets.name: Name
presets.noAccount: Add an account first. Virtual presets belong to a game account.
presets.inUse: {{name}} is still sent by {{modules}}. Pick another plan there and save, then delete it.
plugins.copiedToAll: {{label}} copied to every kingdom. Save to keep it.
kingdoms.noCastle: This account has no castle in {{kingdom}}, so the bot can't attack there. Unlock the kingdom in the game, then start the bot once.

modules.towers.soon.lootPriority.descrip: Choose which resource the attacks bring home first.
modules.towers.soon.stopAfterDefeat.name: Stop after a defeat
modules.towers.soon.stopAfterDefeat.desc: Stop a kingdom's attacks when one is lost, until you have looked at it.
modules.towers.soon.speedBonus.name: Speed bonus
modules.towers.soon.speedBonus.descripti: Use the game's travel speed bonus on tower attacks.
module.global.capOver: The kingdoms that are on ask for {{asked}} attacks a day between them. The account's cap of {{limit}} still holds.
plugins.copiedToAllEvents: {{label}} copied to every event. Save to keep it.

modules.nom-sam-daimyo.soon.nomadAdvisor: Let the game's Nomad Advisor run the Nomad camps for you.

problems.action.kut: A troop transfer to another kingdom
problems.action.kgt: A goods transfer to another kingdom
problems.action.msk: A time skip on a transfer
problems.action.msd: A time skip on a cooldown
problems.action.msb: A time skip on a building
problems.reason.MISSING_UNITS: the troops were no longer in the castle
problems.reason.ATTACK_TOO_MANY_UNITS: more troops were sent than this attack allows
problems.reason.TOO_MUCH_UNITS: it asked for more troops than the game takes at once
problems.reason.TOO_MANY_TOOLS: it asked for more tools than the game takes at once
problems.reason.CANT_START_NEW_ARMIES: armies were sent too close together, so the bot pauses for a while
problems.reason.COOLING_DOWN: the target was still recovering from an earlier attack
problems.reason.NOT_COOLING_DOWN: the target wasn't recovering, so no skip was needed
